capabilities: count total and completed checkboxes in the active note in real time
show a completion counter and percentage in the status bar
show a progress bar in the view header on desktop and mobile
reset all completed checkboxes in a note with one click
ignore checkboxes inside code blocks and frontmatter
extras: Not yet available in the Community Plugins directory; the README describes manual installation from GitHub Releases. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no at-a-glance count of how many checkboxes in the open note are completed versus outstanding.
summary: Status bar counter and view-header progress bar that track checkbox completion in the active note, with a button to reset completed checkboxes.
